title: Floyd Levin leaves; checking on tiredness
summary: Levin leaves for the newspaper office and the interviewer asks if Garland is tired.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: You want to take your coat off? It's kind of warm in here.
Yeah, I'm comfortable. Oh, that's so good to me.
Okay, that's me. You owe me a quarter to me. Listen, I'm going to have to go. I'm going to get over to that newspaper office.
I stayed to help you, but you don't need any help from me anymore.
Okay, well, we'll just keep talking until we get tired, okay? Are you tired?
That's right. Are you tired or anything, Mr. Calder?
Not yet? You let me know.
